drafted_from: Read from tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (workflow:make-it-perform, steps discover, improve, measure); the hands_back follows the step's submit shape.
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:make-it-perform to get my bakery's pre-order page at https://example.com/pre-order found for custom cakes nearby, with no paid ads and the wording kept, and you may edit its title and description."
no_lists_because: The item names no list in its own words, input or steps, so it has no example rows to ship.
instructions: 1. Say the run line in start_here with the request, the page or channel in scope, your constraints and the actions you allow.
2. The AI discovers the current route for each operation (discover), then fixes the actual bottleneck (improve) and replays a real task through the page.
3. After a stated window it compares fresh numbers with the baseline (measure); a blocked or unavailable measurement stays open with its exact gap.
4. Read each step's summary and evidence; nothing promises rankings or impressions.

worked_examples.title: Find what blocks a pre-order page from being found
worked_examples.ask: Make my bakery's pre-order page easier to find for custom cakes nearby.

input.request: Get my bakery's pre-order page found when people search for custom cakes nearby
authorized_actions: edit the page's title and description

worked_examples.given: Read from the discover step in tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json: it inspects the real schema of each operation before acting, reads back the persisted work record and states what is requirement and what is a gap.
